cases.reason: The ErrFinalToken branch stores the token, marks scanning done, and returns whether the token is non-nil. Later scans return false. The branch leaves the stored error untouched, and Err reports nil for both a nil stored error and EOF. The test asserts first Scan results of true for the non-nil empty token and false for the nil token, then false and nil Err on the second call in both cases. It checks Err only after the second call and does not inspect the returned token.

The first Scan sets scanCalled before attempting to read, so the flag is already set when empty input makes Scan return false. Buffer and Split both panic when that flag is set. The test uses a fresh empty-input scanner for each method, checks that the first Scan returns false, and requires a non-nil recovered panic value without checking its message.
